scope: Exact algebra and regulated amplitude audit of inherited finite action; not a physical CST gauge quantization.
prospective_status: Local plan written before computations; qualitative counterexamples and intended analytic results known before certification. Not external preregistration or blind prediction.

conventions.transform: all fields/marks and fixed data transform together where declared

relative_measure.moments: normalization, r_i^2 and r_i*r_j; exact independent uniform moment expansion
relative_measure.negative_control: set T0=0 and keep independent [-L,L] boxes

amplitude_witness.tolerance: rigorous rational Taylor remainder; no empirical tolerance

vacuum_witness.criterion: local translation symmetry iff L v=0; for all T at fixed C,w

boundary_witness.formula: Delta S = delta*sum_B q - delta^2/2 chi_B^T L chi_B
boundary_witness.nonzero_cross_coupling: retain relative clock origin; independent reset is changed model

state_controls.wavepacket: normalized compact indicator, translated together with domain and readout; auxiliary positive norm only
state_controls.relabel: commutation with common clock shift, all permutations N<=4

physical_controls.clock_affine: Gamma[aT+b]=a^2 Gamma[T]; future proper time a=1
physical_controls.geometry: two non-isomorphic orders with fixed fields must remain distinguishable

claims_not_tested: CST boundary charges or edge modes
